batch: 2026-09-02 Cadillac FY2019 adopted operating budget intake 40
method: Computed the supplied PDF's SHA-256 hash and byte size and compared the hash against every published public asset and evidence catalog.
Opened all 235 pages, text-indexed the 234 pages with embedded text and visually checked the image-only cover page.
Rendered and visually inspected PDF page 41 for the Water Resources goals and PDF page 105 for the leachate revenue row and column alignment.
Verified the May 21, 2018 approval date on PDF page 46 and kept the budget separate from the November 20, 2017 official council minutes.
Added the adopted budget once, linked it to its own dated timeline event and rechecked the evidence request queue without closing unsupported requirements.

addedRecord.canonicalName: City of Cadillac FY2019 Adopted Operating Budget.pdf

verifiedFindings: PDF page 105 reports leachate revenue of $447,684 actual for FY2017, $350,000 estimated for FY2018, $150,000 adopted for FY2018 and $150,000 proposed for FY2019.
PDF page 41 lists evaluating new revenue through additional hauled waste as a Water Resources fiscal goal.
The same page separately lists maintaining discharges below NPDES permit levels, limiting industrial waste through active monitoring and maintaining Class A EQ biosolids as environmental goals.
PDF page 46 states that Ordinance 2018-06 was approved May 21, 2018.
interpretiveBoundary: The adjacent fiscal and environmental goals support describing a potential policy tension. The budget does not state that the goals conflicted in practice, identify the source or constituents of additional hauled waste, or establish a permit violation.

separation.resolution: The records are published as separate catalog entries and separate timeline events, with independent titles, dates, findings and source files.

queueResolution.reason: The adopted budget adds aggregate financial and policy evidence, but it does not provide load-by-load manifests, hauler tickets, invoices, payment records, an exact final delivery date, PFAS analytical results or source-to-receptor migration proof.
